newsitem.title: USA: Tessco sees Q4 shr below analyst forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Tessco sees Q4 shr below analyst forecasts.

text.p: Tessco Technologies Inc on Monday it expected its fourth-quarter earnings to range between $0.10 to $0.15 per share, less than analysts' consensus estimate of $0.24.
The company said the expected shortfall reflected the termination of its relationship with Andrew Corp, which represented about 28 percent of fiscal 1996 sales.

"Though we successfully converted a substantial portion of the Andrews business to competitive products and reduced Andrew profit contribution by almost two-thirds, we were unable to make a full transition," Chairman Robert Barnhill said.
He said the company ceased virtually all sales of Andrew products after January 1.
